summary: Develop transport appraisal, accessibility, and KPI planning skills in five days. Explore the course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Transport planning and management helps planners, service managers, and policy analysts assess mobility needs and prioritize interventions. The course covers four-step travel-demand analysis, GTFS-based service assessment, and GIS accessibility mapping, alongside cost-benefit and multi-criteria appraisal. Participants practise comparing options, mapping stakeholder roles, and outlining implementation and KPI monitoring plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, operate, assess, or oversee transport systems and need a practical method for turning mobility priorities into appraised, monitorable policies.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to transport planning, public transport operations, traffic management, or policy analysis is recommended. No programming is required. GIS and demand-model topics are taught for planning interpretation and specification, not technical implementation.
